captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of several disassembled mechanical and structural components for a interlocking secret heart-shaped box. Key visible parts include a long, angled guide-rail beam with integrated cylindrical hinge pins, small sliding blocks with pointed locking tips, a flat curved shield piece, and a tiny extruded monogram letter 'P'. The parts are designed with matching slide tracks, interlocking hinges, and angled surfaces to allow them to pivot and slide together into a finished box assembly.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, all-at-once printable secret heart box in OpenSCAD. The design should feature customizable text on the top faces, adjustable midsection length, width, and height, and include a sliding latch/clasp mechanism with hinges and track guides.
captions.factory: The design is built using several modular functions. The 'base' module defines the basic heart lobe geometry using a union of a cube and cylinders, which is then extruded and intersected. This base is hollowed out in 'hollowbase' and split into left and right halves ('Left' and 'Right' modules) with integrated tracks and sliding point nubs. Hinges are constructed using cubes and cylinders, while 'cleave' splits the upper and lower sections at a 45-degree angle. Finally, the 'assembly' module positions the four quadrants (UpperLeft, LowerLeft, UpperRight, LowerRight) with optional text extruded onto the top faces using the write library.
